title: Create a poll
summary: Starts a poll in a group: a question, 2 to 20 options, one choice or several, and whether the votes show before the poll ends.

options.description: Starts with 2 empty options. A filled last option adds a new empty one, up to 20. Empty options are dropped on send.

multipleChoice.description: false: one answer (max selections 1). true: max selections is the number of options.

hideResults.description: true: PollKind Undisclosed, the votes show only after the end. Default false (Disclosed).

editOption.effect: Sets the option and adds or trims the empty last option.

removeOption.effect: Removes the option while more than 2 remain.

send.effect: Timeline.createPoll with the question, the non-empty options, max selections and the kind, then closes. Off until the question and at least 2 options have text.

notes: Opens from the composer's attachment menu in a group (bipe-chat/bipe#563). A DM has no polls in Bipe's menu: polls are a group tool (product.json polls).
The poll is an m.poll.start event (Matrix spec, MSC3381 as shipped in the SDK); quiet groups notify everyone for it (group-quiet).
At most 20 options: the Matrix poll format allows 20 answers.
